note: The one definition of the browser matrix. playwright.config.ts builds its projects from this file and tests/Support/prepare-browser-contribution.php seeds from it, so a project cannot exist in one and be missing from the other. Adding a project here is what makes it run and makes fixture selection see it; its browser/device emulation must also be declared deliberately in playwright.config.ts. `specs` is `all` for a project that runs every journey, `right-to-left` for one confined to the locale-direction proof, or `breadth` for one confined to the bounded nightly keyboard, focus, touch, high-contrast, zoom and reflow proof. tests/Browser/nightly-critical-journeys.json separately owns the exact project/title pairs that may never rely on a retry. Only `all` projects reach the maker-checker journey, and only they need approval identities.
